records.source: The young leaves of the tea plant. Can be brewed into the popular, energizing beverage.
records.translation: Mga murang dahon ng halamang tsaa. Maaaring timplahin upang maging sikat at nakapagpapasiglang inumin.

records.source: Takes 20 days to mature. Produces tea leaves during the final week of each season, except winter. No watering necessary!
records.translation: Tumatagal ng 20 araw upang mahinog. Nagbibigay ng mga dahon ng tsaa sa huling linggo ng bawat panahon maliban sa taglamig. Hindi kailangang diligan!

records.source: Use this to deploy a one-time-use tent for sleeping. Can only be used outdoors.
records.translation: Gamitin ito upang magtayo ng toldang minsan lamang magagamit sa pagtulog. Magagamit lamang sa labas.

records.source: When enemies damage you, they will take damage themselves.
records.translation: Kapag sinaktan ka ng mga kalaban, masasaktan din sila.

records.source: According to legend, angry thunder spirits would throw these stones at one another.
records.translation: Ayon sa alamat, ibinabato ng mga galit na espiritu ng kulog ang mga batong ito sa isa't isa.

records.source: A stripe of shimmering gold gives this gem a warm luster.
records.translation: Nagbibigay ng mainit na kintab sa hiyas ang guhit ng kumikislap na ginto.

records.englishResidueReason: Slime is the canonical Filipino glossary's retained creature name.

records.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator. Use with extreme caution!
records.translation: Maaaring mapisa sa Pampapisa ng Slime. Gamitin nang buong pag-iingat!
records.englishResidueReason: Slime is the canonical Filipino glossary's retained creature name.

records.source: A rare hybrid trout that cannot bear offspring of its own.
records.translation: Bihirang mestisong trutsa na hindi maaaring magkaroon ng sariling supling.

records.source: A primarily vegetarian fish that prefers warm water.
records.translation: Isdang pangunahing kumakain ng halaman at mas gusto ang mainit na tubig.

records.source: Rich and slightly tangy, the Tomato has a wide variety of culinary uses.
records.translation: Malinamnam at bahagyang maasim, napakaraming gamit ng kamatis sa pagluluto.

records.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 11 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tag-init. Tumatagal ng 11 araw upang mahinog at patuloy na namumunga matapos ang unang ani.

records.englishResidueReason: Tom Kha is the proper Thai name of this dish.

records.translation: Hindi kapani-paniwala ang mga lasang ito!

records.source: Fairly common but still prized for its beauty.
records.translation: Medyo karaniwan ngunit pinahahalagahan pa rin dahil sa kagandahan.

records.source: You feel a little bit safer wearing this.
records.translation: Bahagya kang mas panatag kapag suot ito.

records.source: Provides a modest amount of light.

records.preserveReason: Tortilla is the conventional Filipino name for this flatbread.

records.source: Can be used as a vessel for food or eaten by itself.
records.translation: Maaaring gawing pambalot ng pagkain o kainin nang mag-isa.

records.source: Causes fish to escape slower when you aren't reeling them in.
records.translation: Pinababagal ang pagtakas ng isda kapag hindi mo ito hinihila papalapit.
